name: text-swap
title: Text Swap
description: Change a label, status or short value with y + blur, and spring the width to fit, so neighbours glide instead of jumping. Direction-aware for counts and steps.
docs: Import TextSwap from components/eased/text-swap/text-swap. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
